title: Planning a Lighting Scheme
content: I used two contrasting lighting sources for this painting fromDinotopia:Journey to Chandara.There's a low, warm, frontal light and a high, cool backlight.I reality-checked the effects of such a scheme by shooting reference of me and my maquettes in the same light environment. The Bix maquette is by Jim Henson’s Creature Shop.-----From Amazon:Dinotopia: Journey To ChandaraFrom my web store:Dinotopia: Journey to Chandara
